FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about CortexFin architecture and security.
FAQ.a1: Yes. Wislet uses a local SQLite database. You can create transactions, wallets, and budgets with zero internet. It syncs in the background once you're online.
FAQ.a2: Bank-level security. PIN code and Biometrics (FaceID/TouchID) lock your app. Your cloud data is secured by Supabase RLS policies.
FAQ.q3: Can I share my budget with my partner?
FAQ.a3: Absolutely. You can invite members to specific wallets and assign them strict roles: Owner, Editor, or Viewer.
